name: adaptlypost
description: AdaptlyPost is a social media scheduler for businesses and creators. It lets you create, schedule and publish posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon and Google Business Profile from ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to write a caption or generate an image, attach media from your device or a link, save a draft, or schedule one post to several accounts at once, including posts that repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. Check whether each post went out, and see views, likes, comments and followers for your accounts and posts. Works in every AdaptlyPost workspace you belong to.

defaultPrompt: Show analytics for my social accounts this month
Save a LinkedIn draft announcing our new feature

positive.description: List the social accounts of a named workspace.
positive.prompt: Which social accounts are connected in my AdaptlyPost workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the AdaptlyPost workspace and lists its connected social accounts with their platforms: LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube, X and Bluesky.

positive.description: Save a LinkedIn text post as a draft.
positive.prompt: Save a draft for my LinkedIn saying 'Our beta opens Friday. Join the waitlist at adaptlypost.com'. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the text as a LinkedIn draft and confirms it. Nothing is published. If more than one LinkedIn account is connected, asks which one to use.

positive.description: Attach an image from a URL to a new LinkedIn draft.
positive.prompt: Save this image https://adaptlypost.com/opengraph-image.png as a LinkedIn draft with the caption 'Plan a week of posts in one sitting.'
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the image, saves a LinkedIn image draft with that caption and confirms it. Nothing is published. The uploaded image is stored at a public link.

positive.description: Compare two months of account performance.
positive.prompt: How did my social accounts perform in August compared to July?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows August and July side by side for the connected accounts, such as views, likes, comments and followers, and marks any metric a platform doesn't report as unavailable.

positive.description: Write a LinkedIn caption with AdaptlyPost AI.
positive.prompt: Use AdaptlyPost AI to write a LinkedIn caption announcing that our beta opens Friday. Just show me the text.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a LinkedIn caption about the beta opening on Friday. No post is saved or published. The call uses 2 AI credits.

negative.description: Do not trigger for social accounts the user has not connected.
negative.prompt: How many Instagram followers does Nike have?

negative.description: Do not trigger for direct messages.
negative.prompt: Send a DM to @janedoe on Instagram saying thanks for the shoutout.

negative.description: Do not trigger for video editing.
negative.prompt: Trim this video to the first ten seconds and add subtitles.

review.commerce_description: AdaptlyPost does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release. Create, schedule and publish posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky and Mastodon from ChatGPT.

- Upload photos, videos and documents from your phone or computer through an upload box right in the chat, or from a link.
- Save drafts, schedule one post to several accounts at once, and set up posts that repeat daily, weekly or monthly. Pause, resume or delete a series any time.
- Check whether each post went out on every platform, and retry the ones that failed.
- Read views, likes, comments, shares and followers for your accounts and posts on Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, Pinterest, Bluesky and YouTube.
- Work in any AdaptlyPost workspace you belong to.
